owns: Everything for people who love the ocean.

north_star.summary: Regenerative coastal deals close with fair distribution to builders — ocean love surface keeps people caring.
north_star.weekly_cadence: Strict 2 hours/week max. Each session = one 60-min task OR two 30-min tasks. No third task.

capacity.rule: If a task needs more than 60 minutes, split it before it enters next_tasks. Never schedule more than 2h in one week.

ruthless_criteria.rule: A next_task is allowed only if all of the following are true.
must: description states a clear done/acceptance (what exists when finished)
fits one session shape without a third task that week
serves active_revenue_track OR is an explicit spark on ocean_love_surface
not a vague research fog — name the artifact (list, page, JSON, send, note)
reject: directionless prototypes that ignore software_rule in execution-strategy
affiliate grind while regenerative_coastal queue has READY connect/prosper work

regenerative_coastal.role: Crown cash + meaning — regenerative coastal deals / fair distribution

ocean_love_surface.role: Love engine — beaches, species, conservation trust that feeds the crown

ocean_gear_later.role: Later amenity / affiliate lifestyle rail — not the weekly money path

task_schema.description: Ruthless + clear — enough to start and finish without guessing; include acceptance criteria in the sentence
dependencies: full task index strings only; [] if none
task_schema.lane: optional — build | discover | connect | prosper | polish
task_schema.recurring: optional bool — stays in next_tasks; refresh todo checklist each run
task_schema.todo: optional string list for recurring checklists

how_next_works: When asked 'what next': (1) prefer READY tasks on active_revenue_track (regenerative_coastal → RH), (2) pack exactly ≤2h (one 60m or two 30m — never a third task), (3) skip Parked: unless asked, (4) offer PRIMARY from crown track + optional SPARK from ocean_love_surface if energy is build/discover/polish, (5) after finish move task to done_tasks (recurring: leave in next_tasks, tick/update todo). Reject any suggested work that violates capacity or ruthless_criteria.
